description: An Internet Gateway (AppGateway) is declared but no AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment references it, so it is unattached: the Network Review Source reports it via igw_not_attached. The public route table (AppRouteTable) has no AWS::EC2::Route giving it a default 0.0.0.0/0 route while an Internet Gateway exists, reported via route_table_no_default_route. Both are relationships between resources that a single-resource cfn-guard rule cannot express; they are detected deterministically by iacreview.netgraph. The template is otherwise complete: the route table is associated with a subnet (so it is not orphaned), a VPC flow log is configured, and every resource carries Environment and Owner tags, so no other deterministic Source fires and the case isolates the two network-topology findings.

expected_findings.note: Internet Gateway with no VPCGatewayAttachment, reported by the igw_not_attached detector in iacreview.netgraph.
Route table with no default 0.0.0.0/0 route while an Internet Gateway exists, reported by the route_table_no_default_route detector.
